label: No overdraft
sentence: The wallet never pays out more than the balance, and it gives the right new balance.
reviewer_action: Do not trust the new balance yet: its test cannot fail. Check the subtraction yourself.

label: Safe with many threads
sentence: The wallet stays correct when many threads use it.
reviewer_action: Do not use the wallet from many threads: only the PR text says that it is safe.

label: No leaks
sentence: A denial message names the amount and shows no account number, and the wallet sends nothing over the network.
reviewer_action: Treat the message check as one model opinion. No planted bug tested it.

label: Correct fees
reviewer_action: Read the fee function yourself: no test calls it, and the PR text does not mention it.
